description: This file defines a collection of notification action presets for an Android application supporting wearable notifications. It contains a main class `ActionsPresets` with nested classes implementing various preset actions for notifications, such as no actions, single action, reply actions, and wearable-specific actions.

classes.name: ActionsPresets
classes.description: Main class containing various predefined notification action presets, including nested subclasses for specific presets.

classes.name: NoActionsPreset
classes.description: A preset with no actions added to the notification.

classes.name: SingleActionPreset
classes.description: A preset with a single action button.

classes.name: LongTitleActionPreset
classes.description: A preset with an action featuring a long title.

classes.name: ReplyActionPreset
classes.description: A preset that adds a reply action with remote input.

classes.name: ReplyWithChoicesActionPreset
classes.description: A preset with a reply action offering multiple choices.

classes.name: DifferentActionsOnPhoneAndWearable
classes.description: A preset demonstrating different actions on phone and wearable devices.

methods.name: apply
methods.description: Method to configure the notification builder and wearable options with specific actions based on the preset.
